meta.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code

copy.tagline: 先写测试再写代码，驱动功能实现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果习惯用测试驱动开发流程
copy.tagline_en: Write tests before code to drive feature implementation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you practice test-driven development

howto.what: Claude 会先写测试再写实现:先写失败测试并确认失败原因,再写最小代码让它通过,最后重构;若先写代码会要求删掉重来。
howto.when: 当你提出实现新功能、修 bug、重构或改动行为时,且发生在写实现代码之前;若属于一次性原型、生成代码、配置文件等例外,会先征求你的意见。

say.text: 给 retryOperation 写测试,先红后绿再重构。
say.note: Claude 会按 TDD 三步执行。

say.text: 修复空邮箱被接受的问题,先写失败测试。
say.note: 测试通过前不会写修复代码。

say.text: 给订单模块加退款功能,用 TDD 流程走一遍。
say.note: 开场即触发 TDD 流程。

howto.what_en: Claude will follow TDD: write a failing test, verify it fails, write minimal code to pass, refactor while staying green. Code written without a failing test first gets deleted and redone.
howto.when_en: Triggers when implementing any feature, bugfix, refactoring, or behavior change, before writing implementation code. Exceptions like throwaway prototypes, generated code, config files require asking the human first.

say_en.text: Write a failing test for retryOperation first, then minimal code to pass.
Fix the empty-email bug by writing a failing test first.
say_en.note: No fix code until test passes.

say_en.text: Add order refund feature using TDD: test, minimal code, refactor.
